rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Tarazona 1500 (Missale Tirasonense): complete strict Canon Missae constituent, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (13 February 1500 Pamplona publication (Brocar colophon)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.diocese-of-tarazona.missale-tirasonense.1500-pamplona-brocar.bizkaia-pdf-c6e5dbd8 without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. Third-party historical text is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0 license.
text: Te igitur clementissime pater per iesum christum filium tuum dominum nostrum supplices rogamus ac petimus: vti accepta habeas et benedicas Hec do✠na. Hec mu✠nera. hec sancta ✠ sacrificia illibata in primis que tibi offerimus pro ecclesia tua sancta catholica: quam pacificare: custodire: adunare et regere digneris toto orbe terrarum: vna cum famulo tuo papa nostro. N. et antistite nostro. N. et rege nostro. N. et omnibus orthodoxis atque catholice et apostolice fidei cultoribus.
